name: Homarr
description: A start page for a home server: boards of app tiles and widgets edited in the browser, with integrations for the services it links to. One image with its own SQLite database.

access.note: Homarr starts with no accounts: the first visit opens its onboarding, which creates the administrator and the first board. Open the address yourself right after deploying, because whoever completes the onboarding first owns the instance. Sign-in is Homarr's own username and password (AUTH_PROVIDERS=credentials, the image's default).

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

secrets.name: encryption-key
secrets.label: Encryption key
secrets.description: Encrypts the integration credentials Homarr stores; the image refuses to start without it, and changing it makes every stored credential unreadable.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The boards, the API and the WebSocket for live widgets

volumes.name: appdata
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database, boards, icons and uploaded images

update.notes: Homarr migrates its database on start and does not migrate back; read the release notes before a major version, which can change what a board's widgets support. PORT is pinned to 3000 because the image's own nginx listens on 7575 and proxies to Next.js on 3000; the runtime's default PORT, the routed port, would put both on 7575.
